items.why: Shares are higher after the Meta Connect showcase pushed its Muse AI assistant into new smart glasses and hardware, extending an AI-driven rally with investors also cheering plans for a custom AI chip.
The fear gauge is up as stocks opened little changed and semiconductors slid, with traders pricing a choppier session ahead after the sector's worst week in a month.
Crude gained about 2 percent as fresh energy strikes in Ukraine kept supply risk in focus, pushing Brent toward $104 a barrel.
Chip stocks stay weak after the sector's worst week in a month, with China's CXMT reporting progress in advanced DRAM and investors questioning how long the AI capex boom lasts.

market_note: Futures mixed at the open: Dow futures green, Nasdaq futures lower on chip weakness.
summary: Stocks are mixed early Monday as chip weakness offsets strength in Meta and Dow names. Oil is up on Ukraine energy strikes while the VIX ticks higher as traders stay cautious.
